Population increased in Peterborough

The estimated population of Peterborough in 2024 was 223,655 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

This meant that Peterborough's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Peterborough increased by 3.3%.

Over this slightly longer period, Peterborough was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Peterborough

The average (median) age rose to 36.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Peterborough has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Peterborough is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Peterborough's population of 223,655 usual residents was made up of:

  • 51,216 people aged 0 to 15 years, (22.9%)
  • 140,271 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.7%)
  • 32,168 people aged 65 years and over, (14.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Peterborough has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (22.9% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Peterborough, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Peterborough
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Peterborough, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 853 people (0.4%). In total, there were 2,538 births and 1,685 deaths in Peterborough.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 980 (-0.4%). There were 11,137 people entering the area and 12,117 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Peterborough's population of 2,568 (1.2%) as a result of 4,944 people entering the area and 2,376 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Peterborough was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Peterborough in mid-2023 is 221,283.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,688 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 86 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,774 people.
